```{r, message=FALSE}
# Library Import
library(limma)
library(edgeR)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)

setwd("~/Desktop/Tese/R/Transcriptomic analysis")
```

# 1. Data Import 
```{r import, include=FALSE}

counts <- read.csv("GSE271101_raw_counts.csv.gz", row.names = 1)

#Create copy to work with
counts_gse271101 <- counts

# Remove Length column
counts_gse271101 <- counts_gse271101[, !colnames(counts_gse271101) == "Length"]

# Select only the samples we need
counts_gse271101 <- counts_gse271101[, c("IMR90_hPSC",
                                          "mesoEPC_S1_1", "mesoEPC_S1_2", "mesoEPC_S1_3",
                                          "mesoEPC_S2_1", "mesoEPC_S2_2", "mesoEPC_S2_3")]

# Rename columns cleanly
colnames(counts_gse271101) <- c("iPSC_1",
                                 "EPC_1", "EPC_2", "EPC_3",
                                 "EC_1",  "EC_2",  "EC_3")

```

# 2. Filtration
## 2.1. Before Filtration
```{r filtration, warning=FALSE}

library(ggplot2)

# Calculate log10 total counts per gene
log_counts <- log10(rowSums(counts_gse271101) + 1)
log_counts_df <- as.data.frame(log_counts)

# Density plot
ggplot(log_counts_df, aes(x = log_counts)) +
  geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Total counts per gene (log10)") +
  ylab("Density") +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Distribution of Counts - GSE271101 Before Filtration")
```

## 2.2. After Filtration
```{r filtration_2, warning=FALSE}

# Apply filtration threshold (log10 > 2.7)
filtered_counts_gse271101 <- counts_gse271101[log10(rowSums(counts_gse271101) + 1) > 2.7, ]

# Check dimensions after filtration
dim(filtered_counts_gse271101)

# Post-filtration density plot
log_counts_filtered_gse271101 <- log10(rowSums(filtered_counts_gse271101) + 1)
log_counts_filtered_gse271101 <- as.data.frame(log_counts_filtered_gse271101)

ggplot(log_counts_filtered_gse271101, aes(x = log_counts_filtered_gse271101)) +
  geom_density() +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Density") +
  xlab("Normalised Counts (log10)") +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Total counts per gene - GSE271101 After Filtration")
```

# 3. Voom 
```{r voom, warning=FALSE}

# Create DGEList object from filtered count table
dgelist <- DGEList(filtered_counts_gse271101)

# Calculate normalisation factors (TMM method)
# Note: this step calculates the factors but does not normalise yet
dgelist <- calcNormFactors(dgelist)

# Define group labels for the design matrix
# iPSC has 1 replicate; EPC and EC have 3 biological replicates each

group_labels <- c(
  "iPSC",
  "EPC", "EPC", "EPC",
  "EC",  "EC",  "EC"
)

# Build the design matrix
# ~0 means no intercept - each group gets its own coefficient

mm <- model.matrix(~0 + group_labels)

# Apply voom normalisation
# This converts counts to log2-CPM and estimates the
# mean-variance relationship needed for linear modelling

y_gse271101 <- voom(dgelist, mm, plot = TRUE)

```

# 4. PCA
```{r PCA, warning=FALSE}
# Prepare data matrix for PCA
dfforpca_gse271101 <- y_gse271101$E
dfforpca_gse271101 <- rbind(dfforpca_gse271101, group_labels)
dfforpca_gse271101 <- t(dfforpca_gse271101)

numcol_gse271101 <- c(1:(ncol(dfforpca_gse271101) - 1))

# Convert to data frame and numeric columns
dfforpca_gse271101 <- as.data.frame(dfforpca_gse271101)
dfforpca_gse271101[, numcol_gse271101] <- apply(dfforpca_gse271101[, numcol_gse271101], 2,
                                                  function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# Specify the factor levels in trajectory order
dfforpca_gse271101$group_labels <- factor(dfforpca_gse271101$group_labels,
                                           levels = c("iPSC", "EPC", "EC"))

# Run PCA
pca_res_gse271101 <- prcomp(dfforpca_gse271101[, numcol_gse271101], scale = FALSE)

# PCA plot
p_gse271101 <- autoplot(
  pca_res_gse271101,
  data = dfforpca_gse271101,
  x = 1,
  y = 2,
  colour = "group_labels",
  size = 8,
  alpha = 0.7
)

# Apply manual colors (one per cell type)
p_gse271101 <- p_gse271101 + theme_bw() +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Cell Type",
    values = c(
      "iPSC" = "lightblue",
      "EPC"  = "lightsalmon",
      "EC"   = "lightgreen"
    )
  ) +
  ggtitle("PCA Plot - GSE271101") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  )

p_gse271101

# Top contributing genes per PC
contribs1_gse271101 <- pca_res_gse271101$rotation[, 1]
contribs2_gse271101 <- pca_res_gse271101$rotation[, 2]
contribs3_gse271101 <- pca_res_gse271101$rotation[, 3]

# Biggest contributors to PC1
(pos1genes_gse271101 <- sort(contribs1_gse271101, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])
(neg1genes_gse271101 <- sort(contribs1_gse271101, decreasing = FALSE)[1:10])

# Biggest contributors to PC2
(pos2genes_gse271101 <- sort(contribs2_gse271101, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])
(neg2genes_gse271101 <- sort(contribs2_gse271101, decreasing = FALSE)[1:10])

```

# 5. Heatmap
```{r heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=6.5}

# Define Gene Panel (full canonical panel)
pluripotency         <- c("POU5F1", "SOX2", "KLF4", "MYC")
mesoderm_induction   <- c("TBXT", "MIXL1", "EOMES", "ETV2", "KDR", "CD34")
endothelial_identity <- c("PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "NOS3", "SOX17", "ERG")

genes_use_gse271101 <- c(pluripotency, mesoderm_induction, endothelial_identity)

# Full canonical panel
genes_all <- genes_use_gse271101

# Genes present before filtration
genes_present_prefilt <- genes_all[genes_all %in% rownames(counts_gse271101)]
genes_absent_prefilt  <- genes_all[!genes_all %in% rownames(counts_gse271101)]

# Genes present after filtration / voom
genes_present_postfilt <- genes_all[genes_all %in% rownames(y_gse271101$E)]
genes_removed_filter   <- setdiff(genes_present_prefilt, genes_present_postfilt)

# Print summary
cat("=== CANONICAL GENE CHECK - GSE271101 ===\n")
cat("Present before filtration:\n", paste(genes_present_prefilt, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
cat("Absent before filtration:\n", paste(genes_absent_prefilt, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
cat("Removed after filtration:\n", paste(genes_removed_filter, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
cat("Used in heatmap:\n", paste(genes_present_postfilt, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# Final genes used in heatmap
genes_use_gse271101 <- genes_present_postfilt

# Keep only genes present after filtration/normalisation
genes_use_gse271101 <- genes_use_gse271101[genes_use_gse271101 %in% rownames(y_gse271101$E)]

# Create stage mapping
stage_map_gse271101 <- c(
  setNames(rep("Pluripotency", length(pluripotency)), pluripotency),
  setNames(rep("Mesoderm induction", length(mesoderm_induction)), mesoderm_induction),
  setNames(rep("Endothelial identity", length(endothelial_identity)), endothelial_identity)
)

row_stage_gse271101 <- factor(
  stage_map_gse271101[genes_use_gse271101],
  levels = c("Pluripotency", "Mesoderm induction", "Endothelial identity")
)

# Subset and row-scale expression matrix
mat <- y_gse271101$E[genes_use_gse271101, , drop = FALSE]
mat_scaled_gse271101 <- t(scale(t(mat)))

# Replace possible NA values caused by zero-variance genes
mat_scaled_gse271101[is.na(mat_scaled_gse271101)] <- 0

# Clean column names
colnames(mat_scaled_gse271101) <- c(
  "iPSC_1",
  "EPC_1", "EPC_2", "EPC_3",
  "EC_1",  "EC_2",  "EC_3"
)

# Column groups
col_group_gse271101 <- factor(
  c(rep("iPSC", 1), rep("EPC", 3), rep("EC", 3)),
  levels = c("iPSC", "EPC", "EC")
)

# Heatmap colour scale
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 2),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)

# Top annotation
top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = anno_block(
    gp = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey70"),
    labels = c("iPSC", "EPC", "EC"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold", col = "black")
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  height = unit(7, "mm")
)

# Left annotation
left_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Stage = anno_block(
    gp = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey70"),
    labels = c("Pluripotency", "Mesoderm induction", "Endothelial identity"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold", col = "black"),
    labels_rot = 0
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  width = unit(37, "mm")
)

# Draw heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_scaled_gse271101,
  name = "Z-score\nexpression",
  col = col_fun,
  
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  
  row_split = row_stage_gse271101,
  column_split = col_group_gse271101,
  
  top_annotation = top_ha,
  left_annotation = left_ha,
  
  column_title = NULL,
  row_title = NULL,
  
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 90,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  
  row_gap = unit(3, "mm"),
  column_gap = unit(3, "mm"),
  
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.6),
  border = TRUE,
  
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Z-score\nexpression",
    at = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
    labels = c("-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2")
  )
)

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  column_title = "Canonical marker expression across iPSC, EPC and EC stages - GSE271101",
  column_title_side = "top",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
  padding = unit(c(4, 2, 2, 2), "mm")
)

```

# 6. Export Results 
```{r export}
library(writexl)

# Define full canonical panel for export
canonical_genes <- c("POU5F1", "SOX2", "KLF4", "MYC",
                     "TBXT", "MIXL1", "EOMES", "ETV2", "KDR", "CD34",
                     "PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "NOS3", "SOX17", "ERG")

# Create output directory
dir.create("results/GSE271101", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. Gene availability table
gene_availability <- data.frame(
  gene          = canonical_genes,
  in_dataset    = canonical_genes %in% rownames(counts_gse271101),
  after_filter  = canonical_genes %in% rownames(y_gse271101$E),
  status        = ifelse(
    !canonical_genes %in% rownames(counts_gse271101), "Absent from dataset",
    ifelse(!canonical_genes %in% rownames(y_gse271101$E), "Removed by filtration", "Used")
  )
)

write.csv(gene_availability,
          "results/GSE271101/gene_availability.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# 2. PCA plot
pdf("results/GSE271101/pca_plot.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
print(p_gse271101)
dev.off()

# 3. Heatmap
pdf("results/GSE271101/heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 6.5)
draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  column_title        = "Canonical marker expression across iPSC, EPC and EC stages - GSE271101",
  column_title_side   = "top",
  column_title_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
  padding             = unit(c(4, 2, 2, 20), "mm")
)
dev.off()

write.csv(mat_scaled_gse271101, "results/GSE271101/mat_z.csv")
```

# 7. Linear Models and DEG Analysis - GSE271101

```{r linear_models_gse271101}
# Note: iPSC has a single replicate, thus contrasts involving iPSC have 
# reduced statistical power and should be interpreted with caution

# Fit linear model
fitted_gse271101 <- lmFit(y_gse271101, mm)

# Define contrasts
# EPC vs iPSC (mesoderm induction)
contr_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101 <- makeContrasts(
  group_labelsEPC - group_labelsiPSC,
  levels = colnames(coef(fitted_gse271101)))

# EC vs EPC (endothelial specification)
contr_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101 <- makeContrasts(
  group_labelsEC - group_labelsEPC,
  levels = colnames(coef(fitted_gse271101)))

# EC vs iPSC (full trajectory)
contr_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101 <- makeContrasts(
  group_labelsEC - group_labelsiPSC,
  levels = colnames(coef(fitted_gse271101)))

# Estimate contrasts
tmp_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101 <- contrasts.fit(fitted_gse271101, contr_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101)
tmp_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101   <- contrasts.fit(fitted_gse271101, contr_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101)
tmp_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101  <- contrasts.fit(fitted_gse271101, contr_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101)

# Apply eBayes
tmp_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101 <- eBayes(tmp_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101)
tmp_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101   <- eBayes(tmp_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101)
tmp_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101  <- eBayes(tmp_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101)

# Extract full topTable for each contrast
DEGenes_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101 <- topTable(tmp_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101, 
                                            sort.by = "logFC", n = Inf)
DEGenes_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101$GeneID <- rownames(DEGenes_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101)

DEGenes_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101 <- topTable(tmp_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101, 
                                          sort.by = "logFC", n = Inf)
DEGenes_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101$GeneID <- rownames(DEGenes_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101)

DEGenes_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101 <- topTable(tmp_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101, 
                                           sort.by = "logFC", n = Inf)
DEGenes_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101$GeneID <- rownames(DEGenes_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101)

# Filter DEGs: adj.P.Val < 0.05 and |logFC| >= 1
DEGs_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101 <- DEGenes_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101[
  DEGenes_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & 
  abs(DEGenes_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101$logFC) >= 1, ]

DEGs_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101 <- DEGenes_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101[
  DEGenes_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & 
  abs(DEGenes_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101$logFC) >= 1, ]

DEGs_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101 <- DEGenes_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101[
  DEGenes_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & 
  abs(DEGenes_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101$logFC) >= 1, ]

# Summary
cat("=== DEG Summary - GSE271101 ===\n")
cat("Note: contrasts involving iPSC have reduced statistical power (single replicate)\n\n")
cat("DEGs EPC vs iPSC:", nrow(DEGs_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101), "\n")
cat("DEGs EC vs EPC:",   nrow(DEGs_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101),   "\n")
cat("DEGs EC vs iPSC:",  nrow(DEGs_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101),  "\n")

# Export topTable objects for use in cross-dataset intersection
saveRDS(DEGenes_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101, "DEGenes_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101.rds")
saveRDS(DEGenes_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101,   "DEGenes_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101.rds")
saveRDS(DEGenes_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101,  "DEGenes_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101.rds")
```

```{r filter_degs_gse271101}

  DEGenes_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101$adj.P.Val < 0.05 &
  abs(DEGenes_EPC_vs_iPSC_gse271101$logFC) >= 1, ]

DEGs_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101 <- DEGenes_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101[
  DEGenes_EC_vs_EPC_gse271101$adj.P.Val < 0.05 &

DEGs_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101 <- DEGenes_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101[

cat("DEGs EC vs iPSC:",  nrow(DEGs_EC_vs_iPSC_gse271101),  "\n")
```
